verdict.rationale: Svelte is a client-side UI framework and compiler, not a hosted service exposing an HTTP API, so an OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows no HTTP API for Svelte itself: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all paths, and llms.txt is LLM-oriented documentation, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
